items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev was sick or injured going into his previous fight.
items.quote: What was he? Sick or injured, whatever it was going into his last fight, I believe it.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev beat Alex Pereira pretty handily in their first fight.
items.quote: If you go back to their first fight, which was only a few months earlier, he beat Alex Pereira pretty handily.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks' notice.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks notice.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov possesses big one-punch knockout power and can hunt for the finish.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov does have big one-punch knockout power, and he can head hunt, and he can find that spot.

items.claim: Nikita Krylov has a weak chin.
